headline: 电影新作混战，热剧首播齐发
summary: 本周影市由《另一个妈妈》《狄仁杰之狼人劫》等新片领跑，剧集端《乌鸦学园》《魔女嘉莉》首播，热播《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》持续吸睛。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《另一个妈妈》《狄仁杰之狼人劫》《重生2》等本周领跑。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: Another Mother, Detective Dee: Werewolf Disaster, Rebirth 2 and more lead this week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《乌鸦学园》《魔女嘉莉》《Mayday》《库比蒂诺》《暗潮之下》登场。
industryHighlights.en: New TV premieres: Raven Academy, Carrie, Mayday, Cupertino, and Undercurrent debut.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》《母狮》《无职转生》《末日地堡》持续吸睛。
industryHighlights.en: Hot series: Reacher, Green Lantern Corps, Lioness, Mushoku Tensei, and Silo keep drawing viewers.

industryHighlights.text: 待播待映：《幻视任务》《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》等备受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Coming soon: Vision Quest, Avengers 5, Dune 3 and more are highly anticipated.

headlineEn: New Films Clash as Hit Dramas Premiere
summaryEn: This week's movie slate is led by Another Mother and Detective Dee: Werewolf Disaster, while TV premieres include Raven Academy and Carrie, with Reacher and Green Lantern Corps staying hot.
